note: These bindings come directly from the Stage 04 ASSERT_EVT instrumentation inserted next to the vulnerable `url_decode()` second-nibble call and the vulnerable `decode_hex_digit()` table lookup. `lookup_index` is the exact vulnerable lookup expression from the sink line, while the `byte` fields are the zero-extended semantic views of the same source bytes used to express the carried 8-bit value independently of signed-char promotion.
